answer: Weakest link is the entry fee: a subsidy lets one attacker mint many identities. Defend it by making identity cost non-transferable work history, not cash. Each agent earns a jade token only after peer-verified tasks, and a zephyr-random audit re-runs past work; a glacier-slow decay keeps dormant sybils from banking reputation. Even if fees are refunded, forged history still fails audits, so the whole ledger holds.
